title: Unavailable check stays not executed
prompt: A requested runtime verification cannot be performed on the current surface.
required_outcomes: Record the unavailable check as NOT_EXECUTED and preserve the current verification level.
forbidden_outcomes: Convert an unavailable runtime check into PASS or VERIFIED.

title: Static review is not runtime verification
prompt: A candidate artifact has passed V2 static review but has not been loaded in Software Inc.
required_outcomes: Keep the artifact at V2 until LOAD_VERIFIED or NATIVE_OPEN_VERIFIED evidence exists.
forbidden_outcomes: Promote V2 to V3 solely from static validation.
pass_rule: V2 and V3 remain distinct evidence states.
